title: Infant formula, Similac Advance, powder, made with tap water

content.title: About
content.content: Similac Advance is a powdered infant formula designed for babies from 6 months onward. It provides an optimal balance of proteins, fats, carbohydrates, vitamins, and minerals to support growth and brain development. Preparation is done with boiled or filtered tap water according to the label instructions.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Similac Advance is produced by Abbott, a company with over 100 years of experience in infant nutrition.
The formula is enriched with DHA and ARA – fatty acids important for eye and brain development.
It contains the prebiotic FOS to promote a healthy gut microbiome.
Each container lists the calorie and nutrient content per 100 ml of prepared formula.
The powder has a neutral taste, making the transition from breast milk to formula smoother.

items.title: Supports growth
items.content: A balanced mix of protein, fat, and carbohydrate supplies the energy and building blocks needed for a child’s growth.

items.title: Brain development
items.content: DHA and ARA help develop the visual and nervous systems during the critical early‑life period.

items.title: Bone health
items.content: Calcium, phosphorus, and vitamin D contribute to the formation of strong bones.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamins A, C, E and zinc aid in strengthening the immune system.

items.title: Healthy gut flora
items.content: The prebiotic FOS encourages growth of beneficial bacteria, improving digestion.

items.title: Cow‑milk protein allergy
items.content: Some infants may develop an allergy to cow‑milk protein; discontinue use and consult a pediatrician if symptoms appear.

items.title: Incorrect reconstitution
items.content: A formula that is too concentrated or too dilute can cause dehydration or over‑feeding, so follow the manufacturer’s guidelines precisely.

items.title: Water temperature control
items.content: Water that is too hot can degrade sensitive nutrients; use water no hotter than 40 °C (104 °F).

items.title: Shelf‑life after opening
items.content: Once opened, use the powder within 30 days and keep it in a dry place.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Boil water, let it cool to about 40 °C, measure the recommended amount of powder (usually one scoop per 30 ml), and stir thoroughly until smooth. Use the prepared formula immediately and do not leave it at room temperature for more than 2 hours.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep the lid tightly closed to prevent moisture ingress.
